title: OpenCode plugin dependency bump 1.18.31 → 1.18.34
summary: A dependency-only change: the `integrations/opencode` workspace pins `@opencode-ai/plugin` from 1.18.31 to 1.18.34, and the lockfile is regenerated so the plugin and its transitive `@opencode-ai/sdk` resolve to the matching 1.18.34 releases. No source, build script or runtime wiring changes — the plugin's public surface is consumed exactly as before, only the resolved package versions move.
